Outsider lane is still MAGI-2's launch wave: 13 of 20 outsider picks mention MAGI-2, many with paid-partnership tags and repeated talking points (30s, 1080p, $0.08/sec, 400B open weights); a price war started on 25.11 (YouArt $0.04/sec)

narrative_synthesis: Outsider AI posts from the last ~48h are dominated by two launches. First, MAGI-2 on Higgsfield keeps rolling: creator posts (many marked as paid partnerships) repeat the same specs - up to 30 seconds of 1080p with sound in one generation, $0.08 per second, and a 400B open-weights model 'coming soon'. The angle has shifted from 'it launched' to workflows and price: pounddz (20,411) and rewind02 (4,064) sell Blender-previs or Claude-assisted pipelines with cost claims of $8-10, Higgsfield itself demos Blender blockout to photoreal output, and on 25.11 YouArt started undercutting at $0.04/sec while AI__TSUBAKI claims MAGI-2 is about 84% cheaper than Seedance 2.5. Second, Midjourney's Niji 8 lit up the anime side: aimikoda's 'take AI anime to the next level' clip hit 13,743, and small accounts posting first gens with a practical tip or a 'QT your warrior art' prompt over-performed their follower counts. Side currents: a debate about gating Grok Imagine behind X Premium to cut slop, platform challenges (Topview T1) and fandom anime clips (Blue Archive). On the watchlist the people story won - Gossip_Goblin on Rick Rubin's podcast - and ChrisGwinnLA's Dreamina breach warning shows account-security stories travel too. For Bogdan: a 40K short pitched as a logline plus a previs-vs-final split is the format the wave is rewarding.

x_keywords.method: Read-only x MCP search_posts_all, 2 calls per keyword: last 24 h and previous 24 h (24-48 h ago); lang:en, no retweets/replies, sort=relevancy, up to 25 posts per window. This is a SAMPLE of top-relevance posts, not every post on X. Views = impression_count at fetch time. Rank = sum of sampled 24 h views; 48 h = both windows; trend = 24 h sum / previous 24 h sum (up >=1.3, down <=0.7). Fresh posts are still gaining views, so 'up' is understated. Top-post share > 70% means one viral post carries the keyword.

trend_radar.legend: Trend match 0-100% = 1 - prod(1 - w) over matched 24 h keywords that another author also used in the 48 h window (w: rank 1-10 0.35, 11-25 0.22, 26-40 0.12, curated 0.20). Verdict: >= 50% -> trend; else video/image in the post data -> visual; else >= 100K followers (outsiders without follower data: >= 500K views, estimate) -> author/audience; else coincidence/other. Missing data shows as 'no data'. Heat = sum log10(views) of topic posts (24 h x1, 24-48 h x0.5), scaled to 100. Momentum = log-views last 24 h / previous 24 h. Trend-input-only accounts feed the corpus but are never shown as hits.
